projects.name: WULF Den
projects.quote: Notable milestones include the successful completion of a 2.5 MW HPC proof-of- concept project, specifically designed to support both current and next- generation GPU technologies.

projects.name: CB-1
projects.quote: The construction of CB-1, a 20 MW Tier 3-grade HPC hosting facility, is progressing on schedule and is expected to be completed by Q1 2025.

projects.name: CB-2
projects.quote: Preparations for CB-2, a 50 MW HPC hosting facility, are also well advanced, with key components already secured, positioning the Company for a timely launch by the end of Q2 2025.

projects.name: Lake Mariner ground lease
projects.quote: Securing an expanded ground lease with exclusive rights to 750 MW of infrastructure capacity is a significant milestone in our growth strategy.

projects.name: Lake Mariner Facility
projects.quote: TeraWulf's current operational Bitcoin mining capacity includes approximately 195 MW at the Lake Mariner Facility.
